sentences.content: I just came over to drop off...
sentences.english: I just came over to drop off ..

sentences.content: So that weekend kinda sucked, huh?

sentences.chinese: 那个周末可真够糟心的，是吧？

sentences.content: So I guess this is over?

sentences.chinese: 所以我想这一切都结束了？

sentences.chinese: 因为周末的缘故，我们吵了一架。

sentences.english: If you give up every time you'd have a fight with someone
sentences.chinese: 如果你每次与人发生争执就选择放弃

sentences.content: ...you'd never be with anyone longer than...

sentences.content: No, no. It was a fight.

sentences.content: You deal with it and you move on. It's nothing to freak out about.

sentences.chinese: 你处理好它，然后继续前进。没什么好大惊小怪的。

sentences.content: Monica, I heard you saw Donald Trump at your convention.

sentences.chinese: Monica，我听说你在大会上见到Donald Trump了。

sentences.content: Yeah, I saw him waiting for an elevator.
sentences.english: Yeah , I saw him waiting for an elevator
sentences.chinese: 是啊，我看到他在等电梯。

sentences.content: Rach, can I borrow your eyelash curler? I think I lost mine.

sentences.chinese: Rach，我能借一下你的睫毛夹吗？我的好像弄丢了。

sentences.content: Joey, can I talk to you for a second?
sentences.english: Joey , can I talk to you for a second ?

sentences.content: Yes, but you cannot tell anyone. No one knows.
sentences.english: Yes , but you cannot tell anyone . No one knows
sentences.chinese: 是的，但你不能告诉任何人。没人知道。

sentences.content: - It happened in London. - In London!

sentences.chinese: 这事发生在伦敦。——在伦敦啊！

sentences.content: The reason we didn't tell anyone
sentences.english: The reason we didn't tell anyone
sentences.chinese: 我们未向任何人透露的原因

sentences.content: was because we didn't want to make a big deal out of it.
sentences.english: was because we didn't want to make a big deal out of it
sentences.chinese: 是因为我们不想把这件事闹大。

sentences.content: But it is a big deal! I have to tell someone!
sentences.english: But it is a big deal ! I have to tell someone !
sentences.chinese: 但这可是件大事！我得找个人说说！
不不不不不！你不能这样！

sentences.content: we just don't want to deal with telling everyone, okay?
sentences.english: we just don't want to deal with telling everyone , okay ?
sentences.chinese: 我们只是不想费神去告诉所有人，好吗？

sentences.content: I don't want to see that!
sentences.english: I don't want to see that !

sentences.content: Do you know what's going on in there?
sentences.english: Do you know what's going on in there ?
sentences.chinese: 你知道里面发生什么了吗？

sentences.content: "The most popular Phoebe in tennis is called the overhand Phoebe.
sentences.english: " The most popular Phoebe in tennis is called the overhand Phoebe
sentences.chinese: 网球界最受欢迎的Phoebe被称为上手Phoebe。

sentences.content: If you win, you must slap your opponent on the Phoebe and say,

sentences.chinese: 若你获胜，必须拍一下对手的Phoebe并说道，

sentences.content: That's cute. We really all enjoyed it.

sentences.content: - But you know it doesn't count. - Count for what?
sentences.english: - But you know it doesn't count . - Count for what ?
sentences.chinese: - 但你知道这不算数。 - 算什么数？

sentences.content: Just count in our heads as good Mad Libs.
sentences.english: Just count in our heads as good Mad Libs
sentences.chinese: 就在心里默数吧，就像玩有趣的Mad Libs一样。

sentences.content: Wait, guys, if we follow the rules...

sentences.chinese: 等等，各位，如果我们按照规则来...

sentences.content: ...it's still fun and it means something.
sentences.english: ... it's still fun and it means something
sentences.chinese: 它依然充满乐趣且意义非凡。
